content.label: For a woman in her 40’s that can’t get to sleep I’m gonna tell you all: This app gets you to sleep, or focus, or study, or relax. It’s so good.

This helps me stay focused. I love ambient music and Brain.fm has a ton of ambient tracks w/ binaural sounds. I love it!

title.label: Focus, Relax, or Sleep. Brain.fm Does It All

content.label: Brain.fm is my secret weapon for focus. I use it daily at work and within minutes I’m in deep flow with no distractions, just productivity. The variety is impressive: focus, relax, sleep, even creativity sessions. Unlike regular playlists, these soundscapes feel engineered to actually shift my mindset, and they work. I also love the relaxing and wind-down options after a long day. If you want an app that helps you get things done and recharge, Brain.fm is hands down the best I’ve found.
A smooth very non intrusive app, among all the brain rot.
Huge help. Love this app. PLEASE add a randomizer. The same song sequence plays from the beginning every time I start using the app. This is a basic feature for music apps.

I love this app it gets me going in whatever direction I want to go in. Find your beat and boom you’re either pumped, sleeping, chilling or just plain ole having a really good time. Amazing for my adhd brain!

I enjoy the sounds that really do help me. But the app is horrible. I cannot find anything and the filter function is not really existing. I don’t like the unplugged/classical music though. I’m a classical music buff, so they all sound cheap to me. But the rest is good. Alas, I can’t exclude certain genres from the playlist. The „neural function“ is great and helps!
But I can’t filter for the „neural function“ and the neural function labels are all falsely displayed. PLEASE fix your app, brain fm, please. I end up spending more time in the app than on my work.
Love this app! It helps me focus for work, unwind, and sleep. My only criticism is that it doesn't have Bluetooth. So you can't play it louder on a better speaker. With that, I'd give it 10 stars!!!

I was told I had been given a free trial and would be given the option to opt out or choose whether I wanted a monthly or yearly subscription once it ended. I was never given the options and they charged me the most expensive plan. You would think an app geared towards people with ADHD would remind you that your trial has ended. This is ridiculous

Love the app and the binaural beats, they’re amazing for focus. But I can’t use it because it keeps asking me to upgrade to Pro even though I’m already paying. Tried reinstalling and resubscribing with no luck. Please fix this bug!

I always use this app whenever I’m studying, doing homework, or just doing mind demanding tasks in general. I actually have recommended this app to many of my friends and they find use for it all the time. I strongly recommend!

title.label: Hesitant at first. Use it every day now.

content.label: I was hesitant about the app’s cost. It felt pretty high for a music focus app. I’ve watched a lot of YouTube binaural beats videos for work that were very help with focusing and deep work sessions. So I understood the value of the binaural science there. But those YouTube videos commercials often had commercials. This was cheaper than YouTube premium for the year. Now I use this everyday. It’s amazing how quickly and how long I can get into the flow state while working at work or owes so projects. The tunes are really good. The UI is easy. The customizations are great. The only thing I’d add is some sort of phone focus control that would allow me to lock certain apps between certain hours, then this focus app would be incredible.
Every time I try to log in, the app crashes. Please fix this! I have no issues with it on a browser

Still sorting out if I think it makes a real difference, but what’s annoying is you can’t “control device” and play the audios directly from a homepod, you can only cast the audio from your phone… so if you’re using this, you can’t play any other media from your phone, like you can with Apple Muisc.

I tried signing up, but always gave me an error. After a while of having to reset reset my password I finally was able to get in. The concept is mediocre at best. The user experience is a little rough needs a lot of work. The fact that I had to use three different emails in order to get access just completely turned me off. The fact that I was expecting something incredible and it was just not, just didn’t help with my overall experience. Part of me hopes I don’t get charged after canceling just due to all the glitches.

I tried it with the ADHD settings. It sounds a lot like the minimal DJs I favor, but without any credit to any artist. I might as well listen to and support the musicians I like instead of paying for AI slop.

Any audio with words just distracts me. My zone is Deep Work, Electronic with High Neural Effect. I’m on an 8 week streak. Over the ear headphones, time blocking and nootropics is the sweet spot. But I use Brain.fm every day to lock in!

So I’ve been really struggling with focus issues at work. It started about a year and half ago. I’ve tried brain supplements and drinks for focus. Nootropics and even something called Thesis. But for some reason none of it has worked on me. However when I put on my sound cancelling over ear headphones, and turn on brain.fm I’m so locked in. It’s weird how well it works. I don’t know if it’s a gimmick that neuroscientists actually mimic the brainwaves for focus in the music, but the fact is the outcome is it works. I’ve used YouTube focus music and sometimes that works but brain.fm works everytime. Sometimes I notice I procrastinate by not putting on my headphones to turn on some brain.fm cause I’m convinced I’ll do work when I put it on. Honestly I’ve used screen time apps too and they’re not nearly as helpful as brain.fm. The yearly membership is pretty affordable which I’m getting after my monthly runs out.

title.label: I don’t like it’s made with AI HUGE TURN OFF

content.label: This is cheap and disgusting, 0 effort.

Brain.fm isn’t just focus music based on a desired vibe, it’s literal low level hypnosis. Oscillating sounds complete with cues and triggers that will trick your ADHD with a strange sleight of hand. Effect gets better with use. You can hit Flow State in just a few minutes if you meet the beats halfway. 
Play High Neural Effect Deep Work if you dare. Your cat will start bobbing its head with you…and if you don’t have a cat, you will.

title.label: THIS IS THE BEST FOR FOCUSING!!

content.label: Brain FM helps me concentrate on my schoolwork. I am a high school student with ADHD and I’ve had a really hard time focusing in the past. But with this, my grades are better and I get more done in less time. I’d recommend this to anybody and I’m so grateful for it!

When I found this app I was like ok… I’ll give it a try! I got it and WOW it works. I have to read every day and I always had trouble focusing reading. My mind would go places when I was reading and I would forget what I was even reading and zone out. After I got this app it immediately improved my focusing. It really helps. I sat there for 30 minutes straight reading my book! Definitely recommend.

title.label: NOT FOR ALERT JOBS and maladaptive daydreamers

content.label:
I work at a doggy daycare my job goes from fast to slow and i need to be alert I’m on ADHD meds and I still zone out into another world. I put it on my headphones set it to focus deep work and started watching my dogs. 

I zoned out faster then normal and stayed zoned out until a coworker called my name on the walkie. I came to with dogs playing crazily! 

This app dulls your senses it might be great for office work or a job that is rhythmic but if your job requires you to be alert and aware such as fast food, operating heavy machinery, any work with kids or animals, being on an active construction zone. Ect. This is not the app for you! 

Worst part was after the music my alert senses were COMPLETELY GONE THE WHOLE DAY!

This app does work but it’s not going to enhance your awareness it’s going to reduce it!!!!

If you are prone to daydreaming or getting lost in thought DO NOT USE THIS APP IN A MOMENT YOU NEED TO BE ALERT IN! 

I’m going home now and use this app to zone out and get things done hopefully. 

Great app. Not what I was expecting.

title.label: Amazing and Helps with my difficulties with focusing

content.label: I was skeptical about this app but it help me focus at work, helps me sleep at night and is exactly what my ADHD brain needs to help quiet the noise

title.label: Helps my ADHD and PTSD symptoms.

content.label: I love that the app asks if I have ADHD because that means the music should be different. I have tried listening to “calming music” before but always got irritated or bored. Brain.fm suggested I use high neural effect and it helps immensely with my ADHD. I can put on high neural effect Motivation or Light Tasks to help me get things done. Podcasts are good sometimes but no lyric music is sometimes the exact thing that I need. I can put on chill or destress to help calm after a panicky moment. I listen to Deep Sleep all night. My EMDR therapist recognized that it is an effective tool to help me through transition times and difficult moods. I listen to Learning after an EMDR session and I feel that the bilateral music supports me in that nebulous transition from therapy to the present. Or I listen to Motivation after a talk session and it helps me feel like I can conquer whatever comes next and helps me to focus on the present moment.

This is a great app and I  enjoying it so far. I have decided to replace my normal exercise playlist with biannual beats (BB) in hopes of a more even endorphin cycle. - In other words, instead of the highs and lows that come with traditional music due to being able to get more into certain songs.. using BB for a faster endorphin response, and “more even flow” - all that just to say it would be great to have a category for exercise. Thank you for your time, and your product.
Helps me get stuff done at work, but the playlists aren't very big. You'll start to notice how often the tracks repeat after a couple weeks of listening, which is a little distracting

I really love this app and want to keep using it, but every other month it puts me in a payment glitch loop. Apple says my subscription is active, I’ll cancel and pay again, and this app still tells me I have to renew. What’s even more frustrating is that when I actually press renew again is takes me to the “trial page” but when I pay it loops me back to an expired profile. Messaged support and nothing.
Life changing godbless

Can you listen to music on YouTube for free? Sure, if you want to be distracted by a hundred other videos pulling you attention away not to mention the ads. Brain.fm found the perfect niche people that want to hear the most effective sounds for your brain while staying locked in on a task. The sleep, and meditation playlist is the cherry on top. Great job guys!

I have struggled with sleep for years, and I would wake up multiple times a night. That changed within the first week of using the sleep feature within this app. The music and waves stimulate my brain in a way that I can’t explain but it works. If you can improve your rest, even slightly over time, you can improve your life when you are awake tenfold. The focus feature is also great for keeping my brain engaged and maintained with whatever project I am tackling. The timer is so great. I love to look up while I’m working to see how long I’ve been at it and I don’t have to click on my phone to have the chance to get distracted. 
Lastly, the only downfall for me is that the price is a bit out of my budget but they give you a long time for a free trial. The YouTuber Mark Manson recommended BrainFM in one of his videos and I’ve loved it ever since. Give it a try, your brain will thank you! 😄

I’ve used Brain.fm for over two years to block out distractions and get into deep work. I also love the options for relaxing, which I use to reset when I’m feeling anxious. Great variety so I keep finding new songs I like.
